lines.text: Did you see Steven, when you came home from school or at anytime up until the point you went in ta Steven's house, did you see him go to the burning barrel with anything?

lines.text: (shakes head “no”) Not that I know of.

lines.text: All right. Now we got, we got some other points that we're gonna talk about here. You go there, you get into Steven's house. lines.text: He asked me if I wanted ta fuck the girl and if I wanted to try it. I said ta that I ain't old enough ta have a kid yet so he said yeah, do you wanna try it though? I'm like not right now and he just kept on egging me on.

lines.text: OK and, and did he say anything else to you while he was egging you on? How did he egg you on?

lines.text: And had you been back in the bedroom area yet at this time or no?

lines.text: What, what ah, tell me again what he told you was back there? Who or what?
